leadText:
Skyler (Japanese: トビオ Tobio) is a character of the day who appeared in The Big Balloon Blow-Up. His dream is to become a professional hot-air balloon pilot.

He convinced and , whom he just met, to participate in a Pokémon Balloon Race. His father Tenma lent Ash and his friends a -shaped balloon. During the course of the race, sabotaged many of the competition's balloons and then cheated by using a rocket launcher on Ash's and . Skyler used his Fearow's to destroy Team's Rocket rocket launcher and save Ash's Pokémon.

He tied for first place with Ash; they both won the first place prize, a hot-air balloon engine. However, Ash fully passed the prize onto Skyler to help him fulfill his dreams.
